name: Byss
description: Byss was a world located in the Interior and the Deep Core regions of the galaxy. It acted as the endpoint of the Byss Run and was part of the larger Nexus Route. Discovered late in the days of the Old Republic, Byss was used as a secret throneworld by Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
